priority_items.title: PNG Independence Day early morning; no BPS SITREP or Lloyds reply to RNZ
priority_items.summary: Quiet hour. 16 Sep local Independence Day remains open (POM ~04:51). No new Marape/Toroama Panguna language. NBC provincial Independence copy does not mention Panguna. RNZ 15 Sep piece still says it has reached out to Lloyds. Post Courier LPMEL headline unchanged and paywalled. Fatalities remain PNG-media CLAIM. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 sitting from 19:30 UTC (~0.6 h); MV Matui toll band unchanged
priority_items.summary: Tonga is 07:51 local 16 Sep at cutoff. Official programme lists sitting 08:30–17:10 TOT; Matatoa/ministerial declaration adoption 15:30–17:00 TOT (02:30–04:00 UTC 16 Sep). No adopted text. Islands Business 14 Sep WRP/PIMS series is pre-sitting analysis. Matui still 2 dead / 14 survivors / ~30+ missing. VFSC strike-off remains Daily Post CLAIM; VFSC notices page has no Tui Shipping extract.

priority_items.title: Penrhyn RNZ audio is Palau leftover, not a new US base
priority_items.summary: RNZ Pacific Waves this hour restated Novelly 'possible military presence' / 'friendly port' language on the Omoka/Penrhyn upgrade. Underlying FACT remains the 1 Sep USA–NZL–COK joint statement (US$50m working with Congress; NZ$17.5m NZ implementer; design phase). Not a signed access deal. Not FLASH.
